items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today after being GTD/questionable.
items.why: Groin issue; popped on report but surprising inactive.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevated; loss of red-zone/ dual-threat TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for other IND TEs or WRs in middle of field.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle), previously questionable/GTD, is out/inactive today.
items.why: Ankle injury; limited practice this week, failed pregame workout determination.
items.implication: Browns RBs limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime; major RB downgrade for CLE offense.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup volume spike for remaining CLE RBs in pass-heavy or committee spots.

items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup elevated vs NE.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams is active and expected to start after hamstring issue.
items.why: Full participant all week; Bears plan to start him.
items.implication: Full Bears offense unlocked; upgrade for CHI pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/role for Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, etc.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave and RB Alvin Kamara both active after questionable tags (illness/back).
items.implication: Saints offense at full strength vs Giants.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown and RB TreVeyon Henderson both officially active; Brown returning from IR.
items.why: Sources said likely; activated and not on inactive list. NE close to full health.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Pats offense and fantasy; Brown high-upside WR.
items.opportunity: Brown target share return; Henderson carries/role if healthy.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson out again (ankle); Tyler Huntley starts. Run-heavy expected.
items.implication: Huntley limits pass game; more run for Derrick Henry/others.

items.text: Giants expected to change RB rotation: Cam Skattebo downgraded (still involved) after fumbles, Najee Harris larger role; all 4 RBs active. Skattebo 37th/43 in YOE, 4 fumbles.
items.why: Fumbles and poor efficiency (YOE); sources indicate Harris up.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex/RB2; volume share drop likely vs NO.
items.opportunity: Monitor early snaps; Harris could steal early-down/goal-line.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for TD chance but notes riskier.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring).
items.implication: More work for remaining SF WRs/TE if Evans also limited.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for George Kittle, others in SF passing game (MNF).

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans remains game-time decision/questionable (ribs/Achilles) for MNF; limited/no practice.
items.why: Ribs + new Achilles soreness; side work only, decision Monday.
items.implication: Risky start; monitor warmups closely. If out, SF WR depth thins further with Deebo out.
items.opportunity: Potential boost to Kittle/Cooks if out.

items.implication: Houston RB volume to others in London game.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts placed on IR (blood clot) out indefinitely; RB Saquon Barkley out (hamstring). Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot calf for Hurts; hamstring Barkley.
items.implication: Eagles offense gutted; McKee no rush upside, Pierce or others for RB.
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith full go; streamers at QB/RB.

items.text: Berry updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but riskier flex post-rotation change), Najee Harris RB33. Prefers Najee over DK in some spots.
items.why: Rotation change after fumbles; still likes explosion.
items.implication: Flex over RB2 now; monitor split.
items.conflict: Levitan highlights poor YOE/fumbles supporting downgrade.

items.text: Steelers WR DK Metcalf expected to play/active (illness removed from report); Rico Dowdle also active.
items.why: Illness cleared; confirmed active per reports.
items.implication: Full PIT pass/run options vs TB.

items.text: Berry loves Mike Evans (vs WSH) in Week 6 Love/Hate as WR4 despite GTD status.
items.why: Soft WSH defense for pass catchers; high usage if active.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London (vs CHI) WR6 in Love/Hate for bankable usage.
items.why: Usage you can bank on vs soft defense.

items.text: Berry loves George Kittle (vs WSH) TE3 due to soft defense for pass catchers.
items.why: WSH defense buffet; even better if Evans/Deebo limited.
items.opportunity: Potential volume bump from teammate absences.

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA) WR28 in Love/Hate.
